Drama 3 directs better with short tags, reference clips chosen by how much they sound like the voice, and a safer server. Under the hood, every model now plugs into the studio the same way.

## ✨ New

- **Reference clips most like the voice:** **Dataset clips**, **Save as a voice** and **Change** pick the three clips of a dataset that sound most like the speaker, or the ones with the cleanest transcripts. Drama 3 can also try a few sets by speaking with them and keep the one most like the speaker. The same chooser is used everywhere: the dataset, how to pick, the clips themselves and other clips to swap in.
- **Drama 3 emotion tags:** a new **Emotion** group in the tag strip (`[excited]`, `[happy]`, `[surprised]`, `[sad]`, `[angry]`, `[scared]`, `[calm]`). One or two plain words move the delivery more than a long description, in the text and in **Style** alike. Whispering is the `<whisper>…</whisper>` tag around words: it really whispers, where a whispering tag at one spot only spoke quieter.
- **Drama 3 reference strength** (Settings, off by default): each frame is predicted with and without the reference, and what the reference adds is strengthened.
- **Text box:** inserting a tag or a **New take** can be undone and redone (Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y). A new take inside a pair of tags starts after the closing tag.

## 🔧 Fixed

- The server refuses requests from other web pages: a site open in the same browser could otherwise have sent requests to it. Other host names can be allowed with `POLYVOX_ALLOWED_HOSTS`.
- On 8 and 12 GB cards, speech synthesis waits again while a dataset step uses the GPU; conversions keep dataset work waiting; **Transcribe** refuses while training holds its GPU.
- dots.tts and S2-Pro: after a voice failed to load, the next request with the base model no longer kept the old voice.
- dots.tts and S2-Pro: training writes its weights and its state so that a crash or a full disk can't leave a half-written file.
- Datasets: **Trim all** stopped midway no longer trims the same clips again the next time; a transcript containing a Unicode line separator no longer breaks the dataset; unreadable audio files are skipped and counted instead of stopping a step; slicing after a clean-up counts its clips as cleaned.
- RVC: long recordings are cut in quiet moments (they could be cut in the middle of a note); converted pieces are no longer 10 ms short, which made the vocals drift against the music; m4a clips in datasets work.
- Drama 3: the official weights you downloaded yourself are kept when the studio builds its own copy from them; its memory is freed when it is unloaded.
- The training page and running jobs retry after a failed request instead of stopping; the **Models** tab follows a download that is already running; clips picked late no longer replace newer picks.

## ⚠️ Good to know

- **Updating from 0.7.x:** close the studio and run `update.bat` (`./update.sh` on Linux).
- The first start after updating writes the model name into the settings files of your existing runs and voices in the `lora` folder, once. Files that already name it are left as they are.
- **API changes** (the UI already uses the new ones):
  - Training: a model's own settings go in `options` of `POST /api/training/runs`; `POST /api/training/plan` sizes a run; `GET /api/engines` lists each model's training form.
  - `POST /api/loras/import/{engine}` replaces `/api/loras/import-gpt-sovits` and `/api/rvc/import`; `POST /api/convert/index` replaces `/api/rvc/index`.
  - `POST /api/tts` takes a model's settings only in `options` (the `cfg_value`, `inference_timesteps`, `normalize` and `denoise` fields are gone); without `engine` it uses the first model (VoxCPM). VoxCPM's guidance default is now 1.6 through the API too, as in the app (it was 2.0).
  - `GET /api/status` no longer has `model`, `model_id`, `loaded`, `lora_rank`, `active_lora` or the GPU's training batches; each model's `model_id` is in `GET /api/engines`, and `GET /api/loras` lists a LoRA's `layers` instead of VoxCPM's `config`.
  - VoxCPM packages now name their model in `lora_config.json` (VoxCPM's own loader still reads them).
